blocks.x: If there’s one thing I’ve learned after four years of testing luggage for Condé Nast Traveler, it’s that our editors expect a lot from our travel gear. We demand functional suitcases, bags, and organizers that travel well and actually hold up, trip after trip. Bellroy is a great example of a travel brand that's consistently designing products with thoughtful features, sleek silhouettes, and durable materials in mind. Take its best-selling tech kit—with a spot for every cord and charger you have, getting your tech to and from your destination is a whole lot more seamless with one of these in your personal item.

Bellroy might be best known for its well-designed travel kits and organizers, but its backpacks, sling bags, and suitcases are equally impressive. If you’re on the hunt for built-to-last travel gear, check out Bellroy—and to save a few dollars in the process, take a look through the Bellroy promo codes and discounts below.
Get a 15% off Bellroy promo code for students and graduates

Students and recent graduates, listen up: You can get a Bellroy coupon code for 15% off your purchase when you verify your status online through Student Beans. This means you can save on a new backpack, messenger bag, or tote for school, or snag accessories to protect your phone, smart watch, or AirPods. And if you’re spending the semester studying abroad, Bellroy’s 15% off promo code for students makes buying a new suitcase or duffel bag a little bit easier.
Snag up to 40% off during the Bellroy Outlet sale this fall

Bellroy’s Outlet sale offers deal-seeking shoppers a chance to save up to 40% off select backpacks, sling bags, wallets, and more. Overstocked styles and end-of-season colors make their way to the brand’s Outlet sale before they’re gone, so don’t delay sifting through these deals—they won't hang around for long. Right now, you can save on select shades of the Venture Read Pack ($215, marked down from $269), the Classic Tote ($79, marked down from $135), and the City Pouch ($75, marked down from $95). Also on sale: The Classic Watch Strap is currently 40% off, making now a great time to snag this deal.
Save up to 20% on Bellroy Value Sets instantly

A great way to save on multiple travel essentials at once is by snagging one of Bellroy’s Value Sets. Instead of buying items individually, shoppers can bundle bestsellers and save up to 20%. The Essential Travel Set ($105, valued at $128) is a smart choice for frequent fliers—it includes one of the brand’s popular tech organizers and one toiletry pouch. I'm also eyeing the Big Trip Travel Set, the Minimalist Set, and the Ultra Light Travel Set.
Claim free standard shipping on all US orders

The last thing you want to worry about when you’re checking out is getting hit with unexpected shipping fees. Lucky for you, Bellroy offers free standard shipping on all US orders. This perk is automatically applied during check out, no code needed. Even better, shoppers can combine this offer with an additional Bellroy referral code to save even bigger.
Rescue your discount when your Bellroy promo code isn't working

To help you maximize your savings, we’ve got you covered with a few simple troubleshooting tips to try if your Bellroy promo code isn’t working. For starters, always check for exclusions to a discount code, including on new arrivals and limited-edition collabs. Some promo codes require a minimum spend to qualify your purchase, so double check you’ve met all necessary requirements. Shoppers should also make sure they haven’t already used a particular promo code on a previous purchase and that the discount is still valid.
